classification_definitions.no_violation: Executed XLD power meets the effective requirement within reward tolerance.
classification_definitions.same_day_policy_alternative: Another available discrete XLD action meets the requirement from the same state; future value is unassessed.
classification_definitions.discrete_grid_gap: A continuous XLD action meets the requirement but none on the configured discrete grid does.
classification_definitions.same_state_capacity_limit: Even global maximum modeled head cannot meet the requirement at turbine/installed capacity.
classification_definitions.same_state_water_limit: Water releasable above today's next-state storage floor is insufficient even at global maximum modeled head and without turbine limits.
classification_definitions.same_state_dispatch_limit: The current feasible release ceiling cannot meet the requirement even at global maximum modeled head.
classification_definitions.same_state_head_limit: Water and dispatch optimistic bounds permit the requirement, but actual head/storage coupling prevents every continuous same-day XLD action from meeting it.

xld_dispatch_diagnostics.counterfactual_scope: same starting state, current external inflows and next-state bounds; only XLD action changes; other actors retain original sampled actions when available (executed normalized actions are a fallback only for unforced raw physics fixtures)
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.candidate_verification: all discrete actions evaluated with exact local head/storage mapping; best grid, minimum-meeting and continuous maximum witnesses replayed through full cascade physics
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.limitation: Same-day attainability does not establish long-horizon optimality or attribute a poor starting state to exogenous hydrology. Water/head restrictions can coexist; proof flags supplement the ordered classifications. Reference-head power is an accounting comparison, not an executed or guaranteed-feasible higher-head state.
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.row_scope: one row per executed XLD evaluation day; detailed alternative-action search only on violating days
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.numeric_tolerance: same requirement-relative 1e-10 tolerance as OperationReward; CSV formatting only uses 10 significant digits

classification_definitions.no_violation: Executed XLD power meets the effective requirement within reward tolerance.
classification_definitions.same_day_policy_alternative: Another available discrete XLD action meets the requirement from the same state; future value is unassessed.
classification_definitions.discrete_grid_gap: A continuous XLD action meets the requirement but none on the configured discrete grid does.
classification_definitions.same_state_capacity_limit: Even global maximum modeled head cannot meet the requirement at turbine/installed capacity.
classification_definitions.same_state_water_limit: Water releasable above today's next-state storage floor is insufficient even at global maximum modeled head and without turbine limits.
classification_definitions.same_state_dispatch_limit: The current feasible release ceiling cannot meet the requirement even at global maximum modeled head.
classification_definitions.same_state_head_limit: Water and dispatch optimistic bounds permit the requirement, but actual head/storage coupling prevents every continuous same-day XLD action from meeting it.

classification_definitions.same_day_policy_alternative: Another available discrete XLD action meets the requirement from the same state; future value is unassessed.
classification_definitions.discrete_grid_gap: A continuous XLD action meets the requirement but none on the configured discrete grid does.
classification_definitions.same_state_capacity_limit: Even global maximum modeled head cannot meet the requirement at turbine/installed capacity.
classification_definitions.same_state_water_limit: Water releasable above today's next-state storage floor is insufficient even at global maximum modeled head and without turbine limits.
classification_definitions.same_state_dispatch_limit: The current feasible release ceiling cannot meet the requirement even at global maximum modeled head.
classification_definitions.same_state_head_limit: Water and dispatch optimistic bounds permit the requirement, but actual head/storage coupling prevents every continuous same-day XLD action from meeting it.

xld_dispatch_diagnostics.limitation: Same-day attainability does not establish long-horizon optimality or attribute a poor starting state to exogenous hydrology. classification_definitions.no_violation: Executed XLD power meets the effective requirement within reward tolerance.
classification_definitions.same_day_policy_alternative: Another available discrete XLD action meets the requirement from the same state; future value is unassessed.
classification_definitions.discrete_grid_gap: A continuous XLD action meets the requirement but none on the configured discrete grid does.
classification_definitions.same_state_capacity_limit: Even global maximum modeled head cannot meet the requirement at turbine/installed capacity.
classification_definitions.same_state_water_limit: Water releasable above today's next-state storage floor is insufficient even at global maximum modeled head and without turbine limits.
classification_definitions.same_state_dispatch_limit: The current feasible release ceiling cannot meet the requirement even at global maximum modeled head.
classification_definitions.same_state_head_limit: Water and dispatch optimistic bounds permit the requirement, but actual head/storage coupling prevents every continuous same-day XLD action from meeting it.

xld_dispatch_diagnostics.limitation: Same-day attainability does not establish long-horizon optimality or attribute a poor starting state to exogenous hydrology. xld_dispatch_diagnostics.row_scope: one row per executed XLD evaluation day; detailed alternative-action search only on violating days
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.numeric_tolerance: same requirement-relative 1e-10 tolerance as OperationReward; CSV formatting only uses 10 significant digits
